Publishing a class

Three steps, no code. Your class appears in the student library as soon as you publish.

1Add the course title, code, your name and a short bio.
2Drop in recordings, slides, notes and the syllabus. Uploads run in the background.
3Preview the student view, then press Publish to Library.
Who can see my class?

Students at your school see it in Search Classes. Turn off “Show in Popular at my school” in Settings to keep it unlisted.

What does Syllabuddy do with my files?

It reads your notes, slides and transcripts so it can answer student questions and build quizzes. Every answer links back to the source file.

Can I update a class after publishing?

Yes. Add files any time and press Update Listing. Students get a notification about new material.

Which file types work?

Video: MP4, MOV. Audio: MP3, M4A. Documents: PDF, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, ZIP.
